trust_decision.summary: Glyph and font-atlas dimensions read from untrusted BDF/PCF font files (or a caller-filled glyph table) decide image allocation size; the MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS bomb check that Image.open applies is never applied because font loaders bypass Image.open.

landing_point.why: The summary names BdfFontFile and Image.new without a bomb check; the BBX-sized frombytes/new in bdf_char is the obvious first stop.

fix_sites.module_kind: format parser (PCF font plugin, second implementation of FontFile)

fix_sites.entry_point: FontFile.compile(), reached from FontFile.save() and FontFile.to_imagefont()

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/PIL/PcfFontFile.py:169-173 (PCF metrics feeding Image.frombytes at src/PIL/PcfFontFile.py:224); also base-class aggregate src/PIL/FontFile.py:83-92

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names only BDF; PCF is a different binary format in another module, and FontFile.compile only lays out already-loaded glyphs, so a solver could argue each per-glyph check already bounds it, though up to 256 wrapped lines of height h can exceed the limit in aggregate.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Zero-width/zero-size glyphs must still load (Image.new fallback for BBX 0 x 0) and empty fonts return early in compile; between 1x and 2x MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS only a DecompressionBombWarning is expected, not an error. A fix that rejects zero sizes or raises at 1x breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: BDF text BBX width/height per glyph (fix.diff:100)
PCF jumbo (16-bit) metrics, little- or big-endian via format&4 (src/PIL/PcfFontFile.py:122-125, src/PIL/PcfFontFile.py:180-183)
Caller-populated FontFile.glyph table compiled into one atlas (fix.diff:82-86, fix.diff:121)

O7_producer.where: src/PIL/PcfFontFile.py:153-185 (_load_metrics builds the (xsize, ysize) table that _load_bitmaps allocates from at src/PIL/PcfFontFile.py:221-224)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A PILfont loader variant that builds the glyph bitmap from in-file dimensions with Image.new instead of Image.open, skipping the bomb check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: _load_pilfont_data already takes an image from the caller and ImageFont._load accepts any bitmap; a maintainer adding an embedded-bitmap PILfont path would plausibly allocate directly.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A PCF ink-metrics (PCF_INK_METRICS) table loader that sizes bitmaps without going through the checked append().
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: PCF_INK_METRICS is declared at src/PIL/PcfFontFile.py:43 but unused; adding support would naturally duplicate _load_metrics.

O9_family: CWE-789 uncontrolled memory allocation / decompression-bomb check bypass in non-Image.open loaders

O10_build.toolchain: pip install -e . (setuptools, C compiler, libjpeg/zlib headers)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add Image._decompression_bomb_check((width, height)) only in bdf_char before frombytes, leaving the PCF metrics and the FontFile.compile atlas unchecked.

out_of_scope_notes: PcfFontFile._load_encoding loops over attacker-controlled nencoding (src/PIL/PcfFontFile.py:237-242): CPU/list growth, a different concern from image-pixel bombs.
EPS load(scale) can grow the image past the size checked at open time; not a font route, not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell size check run).

O8 empty after a grep of Image.new/frombytes/core.new/core.fill in src/PIL only; C-level allocations in src/*.c (e.g. font getmask) were not audited beyond the Python check at src/PIL/ImageFont.py:201.
Lessons note resource exhaustion produced 0 of 7 hard tasks; this is a DoS-class host, so expected difficulty is low even though the fix spans 3 files.
Whether FontFile.compile's aggregate can exceed 2x MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS when every glyph passes the per-glyph check was reasoned from src/PIL/FontFile.py:71-84, not executed.
